annotations.title: Create a CookiePilot account (needs e-mail confirmation)

description: Starts a free CookiePilot sign-up for the user's own e-mail address and company, at the user's explicit request. CookiePilot e-mails a confirmation link to that address; no account exists until the address owner clicks it, sets a password and accepts the terms on CookiePilot's page. Returns a setup_token for the onboarding tools and a confirmation_code that the confirmation page also shows. The response is the same whether or not the address already has an account; an existing account holder receives a login link instead.

locale.description: Language of the user (two-letter code): sets the language of the confirmation e-mail, the confirmation page and the CookiePilot panel, and the currency of prices ("pl" = PLN, any other = EUR). One of: en, pl, de, fr, es, it, nl, pt, sv, cs, ro, el, hu, sk, bg, hr, sl, et, lv, lt; others fall back to "en". Defaults to "en".

organization_name.description: The user's company or project name, plain text without web or e-mail addresses

website.description: The website the banner is for, e.g. example.com
